text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Is this the field? Oh, yeah, I can see a bunch of people gathering.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still, I can't believe you offered to help out at an amateur baseball game… You're already so busy with your trainer duties.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days ago, the folks from the local shopping district reached out to me to ask if I'd like to participate in a baseball game.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess everyone does do a lot for me…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But… Ahh, fine. Just don't get too worked up and injure yourself while you're playing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You try too hard as it is, even with your everyday stuff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, it's finally time for the shopping district baseball teams to face off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Neither team gives an inch, and the score remains 0-0 as the match really starts to heat up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wow, this is getting intense. …And you look completely worn out, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I know you're putting in a heap of effort, but I think it's about time you subbed out with someone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're all fired up about this, huh? …Oh, wait, I get it. You're giving this your all because of everything they do for me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Listen, I'm going to grab you a drink, so you just sit here and rest for a while, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez, what a handful… Hmm, where's the organizer tent again?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Juuust falling short, huh? The effort's there, but the points aren't coming…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Oh, are they… talking about Trainer?)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: Probably nerves, right? Joining the team on such short notice means being surrounded by players you don't even know…

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Hmm… C'mon, there must be something we can do to perk that trainer up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (…I kinda feel like I've heard this before.)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Natieeeee! Yeah, just like that! You go, Natieee!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Meeting you and watching you grow into such a fine Umamusume has been the pleasure of our lives."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Whenever I tried to do my best, it was Trainer and everyone else who had my back…)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (I can't just stand around worrying. This time, it's my turn…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally the bottom of the ninth. I step up to the plate needing only a single hit for a walk-off victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The player on the mound has a rocket arm and even made it to the bench of the high school nationals when he was young.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've already got two strikes, so this feels like the end of the line… But suddenly…
You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You can win this, Trainer! Just one hit! Nail this one and you get the win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Let's go! You can do it! Come on, everyone! One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! Go for the win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: L-let's go, Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While clearly bashful, Nice Nature cheers me on. Before I know it, everyone around her has joined in too. I have to win this for all of them!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Come on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: THWACK!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You did it! You nailed it, Trainer! That's a home run! A walk-off victory!
choice_data_list: I couldn't have done it without your support!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Urk… You make me blush when you look at me with that gleam in your eyes…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …And I'm the one who should be thanking you. Thanks for always being in my corner.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I'll just have to keep doing my best… Gaaah! That didn't sound like me at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She might be embarrassed, but Nice Nature's cheers came from the bottom of her heart. What a truly unforgettable day!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Nice. Way to go, Trainer! Great job!
choice_data_list: It was all thanks to your cheers, Nature!
It was all thanks to your cheers, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nah, I didn't do anything special. It all came down to your talent and effort, Trainer. But still…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I guess cheering you on was worth it in the end. Maybe I'll come to support you at the next game. …Maybe not though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Nice Nature shyly averts her gaze, I can really feel the strength of our bond. What a fantastic day!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That was so embarrassing! This just isn't like me at all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ngh, come on, don't yell like that! Everyone'll look! That's it, I'm changing out of this getup!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Well, I'm glad my efforts paid off in the end, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Nice Nature still struggles to be open about her emotions, I can tell just how she feels. What a precious experience!
